text: Evening. Don't mind me. I'm only on my rounds.
Lights out. Last round of the night.
...Shift's over. Someone else has the watch now.
Rounds aren't finished. I'll be back this way.
You stop, I stop. That's only manners.
Everyone has a page. Find yours.
It's three o'clock. It's always three o'clock in here.
Let's have a look at you.
...stood very still. Thought I wouldn't see.
